posts.title: Reign of Christ | Saturday 28 Nov 2026: Psalm 80:1-7, 17-19; Micah 2:1-13; Matthew 24:15-31 ~ Christ will return with great power and glory!
posts.description: Reign of Christ | Saturday 28 Nov 2026 Year A in The Revised Common Lectionary ends today. Year B begins tomorrow with The First Sunday in Advent . + In the name of the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Amen Opening prayer: Stir up, O Lord, the wills of your faithful people, that bringing forth in abundance the fruit of good works, they may be abundantly rewarded when our Savior Jesus Christ comes to restore all things; who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen. “And they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.” (Matthew 24:30) __________ Psalms: Psalm 80:1-7, 17-19 – Revive & Restore – Barb Cordle __________ OT Reading: Micah 2 (NLT) Judgment against Wealthy Oppressors 2:1 What sorrow awaits you who lie awake at night, thinking up evil plans. posts.title: Thanksgiving Day | Thursday 26 Nov 2026: Deuteronomy 8:7-18; Psalm 65; 2 Corinthians 9:6-15; Luke 17:11-19 ~ Thank God for his goodness and grace!
posts.description: Thanksgiving Day | Thursday 26 Nov 2026 + In the Name of the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Amen. Opening: Most merciful Father, we humbly thank you for all your gifts so freely bestowed upon us: for life and health and safety, for strength to work and leisure to rest, for all that is beautiful in creation and in human life; but above all we thank you for our spiritual mercies in Christ Jesus our Lord; who with you and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, one God, for ever and ever. One of [the lepers], when he saw that he was healed, came back to Jesus, shouting, “Praise God!” (Luke 17:15) __________ Now Thank We All Our God | Huddersfield Choral Society / Chet Valley Hymns and Songs __________ OT Reading: Deuteronomy 8:7-18 (NLT) 8:7 For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land of flowing streams and pools of water, with fountains and springs that gush out in the valleys and hills.
